decoded_strings.decryption_note: Running the encrypt() transform over g_encrypted_sc with the above key yields the 96-byte payload that is executed; decrypt() literally calls encrypt(), so the stored blob was pre-processed with the inverse of this transform by the author.

encryption_details.algorithm: Custom toy cipher branded 'AES-256' (class AES256Provider). NOT real AES: per 16-byte block, 14 rounds; each byte: b = AES_SBOX[b] XOR key[i % 32] XOR ((round * 0x1b) & 0xFF). Uses the standard AES S-box (stored at 0x14002F150) plus XOR key schedule and round constants. decrypt() is a thunk that simply invokes encrypt() (vtable 0x14002F250: slot+0x20 = encrypt), i.e. the transform is applied as-is to produce the payload.
encryption_details.key_storage: Hardcoded in plaintext in .rdata at 0x14002F0F0; encrypted 96-byte shellcode blob g_encrypted_sc in .data at 0x14003E000
